Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Model of a Masked, Tumor-Activated Antibody -
Supplementary material


Mark Stroh1, Jason Sagert1, John Burke2, Joshua Apgar2, Lin Lin2, Bjorn Miliard2, Michael
Kavanaugh1

1
    CytomX Therapeutics, Inc., South San Francisco, California, USA;
2
    Applied BioMath, Lincoln, MA, USA.




The model code is provided here in a format that can be implemented in Matlab via
KroneckerBio. KroneckerBio is in turn a systems biology and QSP modeling toolbox for
Matlab. KroneckerBio is open source software and is maintained at https://github.com/
kroneckerbio.


The model described in this paper can be written compactly as a set of ordinary differential
equations of the form:
                                 dx
                                      = k + A1 x + A2 (x ?x)
                                 dt


The 52 Pb-Tx states corresponding to the concentrations in vector x are first provided below
using the subscripting convention is as summarized in the following schematic for Pb-Tx in the
central, peripheral, and tumor compartments (with subscripts _central, _peripheral, and _tumor,
respectively), and that are unbound, bound to receptor (with 'R' appended to the subscript), or
undergoing specific and nonspecific elimination (_el and _tmdd, respectively):
